reserves.name: Mexican-peso fiat deposits in a Mexican bank account

sources.label: Independent public accountant certification for wMXN - June 2026

reserveReview.rationale: The June 30, 2026 certification reconciles 968,789 outstanding wMXN across seven chains to MXN2,086,193.01 in a Mexican bank account and certifies full local-currency backing. Pablo Eduardo Soto signed the certification on July 28, 2026 for SLD y Asociados S.A. The engagement expressly does not constitute an audit or review and expresses no professional opinion. The bank and account terms remain undisclosed, and the collateral surplus is unexplained. The official wFIAT attestation index serves this report as its latest wMXN evidence on September 30, 2026; the 92-day-old balance date remains outside the live adapter's 33-day freshness ceiling.

sources.label: Independent public accountant certification for wMXN - March 2026

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The March 31, 2026 certification by Pablo Eduardo Soto (Certified Public Accountant, Professional Council of Economic Sciences of CABA) reconciled 518,689 outstanding wMXN to MXN 937,364.13 on a Mexican bank statement but is expressly not an audit or review. It is an agreed-procedures certification on client-supplied documents, and it is the first wMXN attestation published. The bank is not named; account segregation, insolvency protections, and rehypothecation terms are undisclosed, and the certified collateral-to-token surplus (~1.81x) is unexplained in the document.
